categories.name: rpc
categories.evidence: Matches RPC/REST/ZMQ label and touches HTTP server implementation in src/httpserver.cpp and src/httpserver.h.
categories.rationale: Improves HTTP server connection cleanup logic by converting MaybeDisconnect to a const method, correcting misleading idle-timeout logging, and adding unit tests for disconnect conditions. Following libevent removal, the disconnection handling lacked test coverage and logged misleading idle timeouts for connections flagged for termination.
